Nicktoons.uk.desc: Simon goes missing and no one else notices in 'Oh Brother Where Art Thou', then in 'The Wall', the girls at school cast votes for the cutest chipmunk on the bathroom wall.

Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin regrets pranking Simon after facing payback in 'Curiosity Killed The Alvin', then in 'House Pest', Miss Croner moves in and annoys the chipmunks.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin is convinced his mojo was in a cap he gave away in 'Mojo Missing', then in 'Who's The Animal', Alvin finds himself mistaken for a Tasmanian devil during a costume visit to the zoo.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Dave's amnesia lets the boys skip school for skiing in 'Dave Rebooted', then in 'Germs', ,Theodore fears germs after a school talk.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Miss Miller gets robbed in 'The Great Chipmunk Detective', and in 'Guitar Hero', Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she needs to learn.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul-mate in 'Albrittina', then in 'Simon for President', Simon and Alvin decide to launch their own campaigns for class president.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Jeanette signs The Chipmunks and Chipettes up for a competition in 'Going Green', then in 'Tattle Tail', Alvin likes a girl at school so he agrees to look after her talking bird.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Theodore's new toy is annoying Alvin and Simon in 'Talking Teddy', then in 'Principal Interest', Alvin is none-too thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new Principal.
